taco-trali.l: Onset within 6 hours of the transfusion (an entry criterion for both)
New hypoxemia with bilateral pulmonary infiltrates (an entry criterion for both)
Raised natriuretic peptide, or a rise from the pre-transfusion value (points to circulatory overload)
Positive fluid balance (points to circulatory overload)
Raised central venous or pulmonary artery pressure (points to circulatory overload)
Cardiogenic signs: a third heart sound, widened pulse pressure, or raised jugular venous pressure (points to circulatory overload)
Improvement with diuresis (points to circulatory overload)
No evidence of hydrostatic pulmonary edema (points to acute lung injury)
No other risk factor for acute respiratory distress syndrome, or one present but stable (points to acute lung injury)

takayasu-acr-eular-2022.l: Absolute requirement — age ≤ 60 years at diagnosis
Absolute requirement — evidence of vasculitis on imaging
Carotid artery abnormality — reduced/absent pulse or tenderness (+2)
Abdominal aorta with renal or mesenteric involvement (+3)
Number of affected arterial territories (one +1 / two +2 / three or more +3)
